en: Is everyone here!? Guys, it's serious!

Yeah, you found the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>, 
didn't you? Let's use it already!
Oh...sorry. It's not the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

...It's not? I honestly thought that's what
all this was about.

Then why did you call us all here!? 
I had to go to the bathroom!

I found...something pretty serious.
I thought I should tell everyone right away...
<CLT=cltMIND>Pretty serious?
Hey...has anyone seen Kokichi?
N-No, I haven't, but...
I see... Where could he have gone?

Once again, I'm reminded of just how few of
us are left...

It used to take quite a bit of time for us all to
gather. But that's not the case anymore...

Let's hurry up and get this over with.
I-I gotta go to the bathroom.

I don't know what this serious thing is
that Tsumugi's talking about...

But it looks like no one found a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback
Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> yet.
So what did you find?

Those letters Gonta found in the courtyard...
There's more added to them again.
The letters in the courtyard?

It looks like the message is complete now.
We can finally read it.
And it says...
"This world is mine..."
"This world is mine. Kokichi Oma"
That's what's written there.
...This world is mine?

Wh-What's going on?
Why is Kokichi's name—

Heh, so that's what it means. It was all
just a prank by Kokichi.
...A prank?

He kept adding to that message just so
he could make fun of us.
Seriously...what a messed up guy.

Nyeeeh...I see. That definitely seems like 
something Kokichi would do.

<CLT=cltMIND>That is true, but...
is that all there is to it?

<CLT=cltMIND>When Gonta had first found the
writing, all it said was...
<CLT=cltMIND>"horse a"
<CLT=cltMIND>Over time, more letters were added.
<CLT=cltMIND>Eventually, it read...

<CLT=cltMIND>"This world is mine.
Kokichi Oma"

<CLT=cltMIND>Can we really just ascribe it
to Kokichi's pranks?

Well, who cares about Kokichi. More importantly,
what about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
It seems no one has found it yet.

Maybe...that's Kokichi's fault, too?
He probably found it first and hid it.
Hm, that is possible.
We need to do something and find him—
No, there's no need to bother with him...

The best way to deal with guys like him is
to ignore them. So let's just leave him be.

You say that, but you were the angriest
out of all of us.

No...there was something I was
just thinking about.
Thinking about?

It's still a little too early to tell 
you guys, but...

Well, just leave it to me. There's no need
for you guys to worry.
I'll figure it all out.
Figure what out..?
I mean, I'm gonna get you guys out of here.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito...is going to get us out of here?
Nyeeeh, there's that reckless confidence again.
Reckless?

Heh, you guys just don't get it.
Geez, heroes are always misunderstood.

Hero or whatever, it doesn't matter...
Just don't overdo it.
Yeah, leave it to me!
<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps Kaito's confidence is baseless...

<CLT=cltMIND>But it's sort of a relief to have someone
so confident in a time like this.

<CLT=cltMIND>A hero...
He might really be one.

<CLT=cltMIND>We weren't able to find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>,
so we all left the dining hall...
<CLT=cltMIND>And returned to our rooms.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi said it was something serious.
I should ask her about it.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."
<CLT=cltMIND>I should talk to Tsumugi.
